definitions.name: U3C.JOINSP
definitions.body: '' [ 'EL' BIND ' ' EL 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: U3C.TITLE
definitions.body: LOWER 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: String word -> lower case with its first letter in upper case

definitions.name: U3C.FIRSTMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its first maximum

definitions.name: U3C.STK
definitions.body: [ 'Z' ] [ 'CH' BIND 'ST' BIND ST -1 TAKE 0 GET CH 2 COLLECT JOIN 'PR' BIND PR '()' EQ NOT PR '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT 'TR' BIND ST -1 DROP ST CH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 TR SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of single bracket Strings -> final stack as a Vector (sentinel 'Z' at bottom); a close that does not match the top is pushed, so the length minus one is the unmatched count

definitions.name: U3C.PREV
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV 0 GET 1 COLLECT XV XV LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE CONCAT
definitions.note: Vector -> the vector shifted right by one place, its first element repeated in front

definitions.name: U3C.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV U3C.PREV 'XB' BIND XV XB LT NOT XV XB GT NOT AND NOT 'XT' BIND 1 0 XT SELECT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> run id at each position, the id rising by one at every change of value

definitions.name: U3C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S S LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S S LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle numbers when the count is even)

definitions.name: U3C.MISS
definitions.note: Vector of readings -> numeric flags, 1 where the reading is missing and 0 where present

definitions.name: U3C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP U2A.GSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'CH' BIND CH '(' EQ NOT CH '[' EQ NOT AND NOT 'TR' BIND 1 -1 TR SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND 0 N RANGE 'KS' BIND KS [ 'K' BIND V K TAKE U3C.STK LENGTH 1 EQ ] MAP 'TV' BIND KS 0 TV SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.top_name: U3C.BYNAME 'R' BIND R VALUES U3C.FIRSTMAX 'I' BIND R KEYS I GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: U3C.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'NM' BIND R NM GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E [ 1 GET ] MAP U3C.FIRSTMAX 'I' BIND E I GET
solutions.messy.top_word: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS 'K' BIND K T VALUES U3C.FIRSTMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ U3C.TITLE ] MAP U3C.JOINSP
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT U3C.JOINSP
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP U3C.FIRSTMAX 'I' BIND W I GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: G0A.WORDS TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS 'K' BIND K T VALUES U3C.FIRSTMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V U3C.RUNIDS 'I' BIND I V GROUP VALUES [ 'G' BIND G 0 GET G LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND V U3C.PREV 'B' BIND B V LT 'IV' BIND 1 0 IV SELECT 0 [ 'E' BIND E MUL 1 ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'V' BIND V U3C.RUNIDS 'I' BIND I V GROUP VALUES [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.second_largest: 'V' BIND V UNIQUE SORT 'D' BIND D LENGTH 'N' BIND NIL D N 2 SUB GET N 2 LT SELECT
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES U3C.FIRSTMAX 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET 'MK' BIND MK NIL V LENGTH T VALUES I GET 2 MUL LT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'R' BIND R R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'AC' BIND E AC E NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: U3C.MISS 0 [ 'E' BIND 1 ADD E MUL ] SCAN 'LN' BIND LN 0 GT LN 2 LT AND 'TV' BIND 1 0 TV SELECT G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: U3C.MISS 0 [ 'E' BIND 1 ADD E MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'R' BIND R 1 DROP R R LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'R' BIND R R [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'P' BIND R P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V U3C.MED 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D 0 D SUB MAX U3C.MED
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V V LENGTH 2 SUB TAKE V 1 DROP V LENGTH 2 SUB TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: SORT TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS 'K' BIND K T VALUES U3C.FIRSTMAX GET
solutions.series.trimmed: SORT 'S' BIND S 1 DROP S LENGTH 2 SUB TAKE G0A.MEAN
